Using appropriate software to evaluate data based on internal and external specifications, support the continuous improvement of lab and plant processes through QA/QC activities and meet and/or exceed customer expectations.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Analyze raw materials, intermediate products, finished products and other chemical samples and evaluate suitability according to established specifications to ensure quality and availability of final product. Analyze samples, provide quality data and become an active member along with the Lab Supervisor and Production personnel to provide innovative ideas to improve lab and plant processes and demonstrate continuous improvement. Know, understand and use software tools such as Lotus Notes, [Product name masked], SAP, Microsoft Office Programs, etc. Which enhance quality reporting. Ensure the suitability of laboratory equipment through proper operation, maintenance, calibration, verification and good quality control and assessment activities. Generate quality data and significant statistical data to support plant personnel in their efforts to enhance process control, meet customer requirements and continuously improve our product quality characteristics.
Perform analysis of raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods, in a timely manner, to verify conformance to or prescribe appropriate adjustment to product so they meet specifications that have been agreed upon by [Company name masked] and their customers or suppliers.
Perform all tests on applicable products. Analyze and record the test results. Effectively communicate with operations. Interpret and follow documented procedures and STI's. Experience working in a chemical manufacturing laboratory environment
Basic understanding of general chemistry
Basic understanding of theory, operation, calibration, maintenance and troubleshooting of laboratory instrumentation such as gas chromatographs, viscometers, spectrophotometers, pH meters, titrators, etc.
Basic understanding of the techniques of quality assurance and quality control
Basic understanding of math and statistics
Basic computer skills using software packages such as Microsoft Office, Power BI, SAP, Lotus Notes, etc.
Ability to work as part of a team, understand chemical and instrument measurement processes, be self-motivated, and willing to develop technical knowledge and understanding of the chemical and measurement processes involved in their respective units
Willing to work in a team-oriented atmosphere, including learning all tasks and equipment associated with product testing, helping coordinate the flow of work within the team and with other departments, and helping team associates to meet changing work demands
Computer literate; scientific minded and detail oriented
Preferred Requirements:
Previous quality control experience, including 2 years chemistry related experience
Basic understanding of ISO/RCMS quality system requirements
Physical Requirements:
Occasional lifting, bending and twisting of various range and motion requiring physical exertion when handling materials, drums or equipment. Occasional use of stairs required. Occasional use of respiratory protection.

cond_0056.responsibilities: Analyze raw materials, intermediate products, finished products and other chemical samples and evaluate suitability according to established specifications to ensure quality and availability of final product. Analyze samples, provide quality data and become an active member along with the Lab Supervisor and Production personnel to provide innovative ideas to improve lab and plant processes and demonstrate continuous improvement. Know, understand and use software tools such as Lotus Notes, [Product name masked], SAP, Microsoft Office Programs, etc. Which enhance quality reporting. Generate quality data and significant statistical data to support plant personnel in their efforts to enhance process control, meet customer requirements and continuously improve our product quality characteristics.
cond_0056.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Demonstrated expertise working in a chemical manufacturing laboratory environment.
Solid understanding of general chemistry and advanced knowledge of theory, operation, calibration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of laboratory instrumentation such as gas chromatographs, viscometers, spectrophotometers, pH meters, titrators, etc.
Proven track record performing analysis of raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods in a timely manner, verifying conformance to or prescribing appropriate adjustments so products meet agreed-upon specifications.
Advanced knowledge of quality assurance and quality control techniques.
Strong command of math and statistics as applied in a laboratory setting.
Strong command of software packages such as Microsoft Office, Power BI, SAP, Lotus Notes, etc.
Ability to perform all tests on applicable products, analyze and record results, and effectively communicate findings to appropriate personnel.
Expertise in interpreting and following documented procedures and STIs.
Demonstrated ability to perform equipment control plans to verify conformance and maintain a clean working environment.
Exceptional attention to detail and a scientific mindset.
Ability to perform all required health and safety inspections at prescribed frequencies and participate in safe work practices.
Strong leadership abilities within a team-based environment, including coordinating workflow within the team and with other departments.
Preferred Requirements
Minimum 2 years of chemistry-related quality control experience in a chemical manufacturing environment.
Proficiency in ISO/RCMS quality system requirements.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific discipline required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Ability to influence and support continuous improvement initiatives across lab and plant processes.
Physical Requirements
Occasional lifting, bending and twisting of various range and motion requiring physical exertion when handling materials, drums or equipment.
Occasional use of stairs.
Occasional use of respiratory protection.

cond_0106.responsibilities:
Analyze raw materials, intermediate products, finished products, and other chemical samples and evaluate suitability according to established specifications to ensure quality and availability of final product.
Analyze samples and provide quality data; contribute ideas to the Lab Supervisor and Production personnel to improve lab and plant processes and support continuous improvement.
Use software tools such as Lotus Notes, [Product name masked], SAP, Microsoft Office Programs, etc. To support quality reporting.
Ensure the suitability of laboratory equipment through proper operation, maintenance, calibration, verification, and good quality control and assessment activities.
Generate quality data and statistical data to support plant personnel in their efforts to enhance process control, meet customer requirements, and continuously improve product quality characteristics.
Perform analysis of raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods in a timely manner to verify conformance or prescribe appropriate adjustments so products meet agreed specifications.
Learn all tasks and equipment associated with product testing; help coordinate the flow of work within the team and with other departments to meet changing work demands.
Perform all tests on applicable products; analyze and record test results.
Interpret and follow documented procedures and STIs.
Document and report results to the appropriate personnel.
Participate in safe work practices.
Perform equipment control plan to verify conformance.
Maintain a clean working environment.
Perform all required health and safety inspections at prescribed frequencies.
cond_0106.requirements:
Ability to work as part of a team and understand chemical and instrument measurement processes.
Willingness to develop technical knowledge and understanding of the chemical and measurement processes involved in the respective units.
Experience working in a chemical manufacturing laboratory environment.
Basic understanding of general chemistry.
Basic understanding of theory, operation, calibration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of laboratory instrumentation such as gas chromatographs, viscometers, spectrophotometers, pH meters, titrators, etc.
Basic understanding of quality assurance and quality control techniques.
Basic understanding of math and statistics.
Basic understanding of ISO/RCMS quality system requirements.
Basic computer skills using software packages such as Microsoft Office, Power BI, SAP, Lotus Notes, etc.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting.
Scientific minded and detail oriented.
Previous quality control experience; 2 years of chemistry-related experience preferred.
Physical requirements: occasional lifting, bending, and twisting of various range and motion requiring physical exertion when handling materials, drums, or equipment; occasional use of stairs; occasional use of respiratory protection.

cond_0145.intro: This position is responsible for quality assurance testing of in process samples, raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods within the scope of the [Company name masked] Quality Policy. Using appropriate software to evaluate data based on internal and external specifications, support the continuous improvement of lab and plant processes through QA/QC activities and meet and/or exceed customer expectations.
cond_0145.responsibilities:
Analyze raw materials, intermediate products, finished products and other chemical samples and evaluate suitability according to established specifications to ensure quality and availability of final product. Analyze samples, provide quality data and become an active member along with the Lab Supervisor and Production personnel to provide innovative ideas to improve lab and plant processes and demonstrate continuous improvement. Know, understand and use software tools such as Lotus Notes, [Product name masked], SAP, Microsoft Office Programs, etc. Which enhance quality reporting. Ensure the suitability of laboratory equipment through proper operation, maintenance, calibration, verification and good quality control and assessment activities. Generate quality data and significant statistical data to support plant personnel in their efforts to enhance process control, meet customer requirements and continuously improve our product quality characteristics.
Perform analysis of raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods, in a timely manner, to verify conformance to or prescribe appropriate adjustment to product so they meet specifications that have been agreed upon by [Company name masked] and their customers or suppliers.
Perform all tests on applicable products. Analyze and record the test results. Effectively communicate with operations. Interpret and follow documented procedures and STI's. Effectively communicate results to the appropriate personnel. Participate in safe work practices. Perform equipment control plan to verify conformance. Maintain a clean working environment. Perform effectively in a team-based environment. Perform all required health and safety inspections at prescribed frequencies.
cond_0145.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Experience working in a chemical manufacturing laboratory environment
Basic understanding of general chemistry
Basic understanding of theory, operation, calibration, maintenance and troubleshooting of laboratory instrumentation such as gas chromatographs, viscometers, spectrophotometers, pH meters, titrators, etc.
Basic understanding of the techniques of quality assurance and quality control
Basic understanding of math and statistics
Basic computer skills using software packages such as Microsoft Office, Power BI, SAP, Lotus Notes, etc.
Ability to work as part of a team, understand chemical and instrument measurement processes, be self-motivated, and willing to develop technical knowledge and understanding of the chemical and measurement processes involved in their respective units
Willing to work in a team-oriented atmosphere, including learning all tasks and equipment associated with product testing, helping coordinate the flow of work within the team and with other departments, and helping team associates to meet changing work demands
Computer literate; scientific minded and detail oriented
Preferred Requirements:
Previous quality control experience, including 2 years chemistry related experience
Basic understanding of ISO/RCMS quality system requirements
Physical Requirements:
Occasional lifting, bending and twisting of various range and motion requiring physical exertion when handling materials, drums or equipment. Occasional use of stairs required. Occasional use of respiratory protection.

cond_0175.intro: This position is responsible for quality assurance testing of in process samples, raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods within the scope of the [Company name masked] Quality Policy. Using appropriate software to evaluate data based on internal and external specifications, support the continuous improvement of lab and plant processes through QA/QC activities and meet and/or exceed customer expectations. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the kind of chemical and measurement work involved.
cond_0175.responsibilities: Analyze raw materials, intermediate products, finished products and other chemical samples and evaluate suitability according to established specifications to ensure quality and availability of final product. Analyze samples, provide quality data and become an active member along with the Lab Supervisor and Production personnel to provide innovative ideas to improve lab and plant processes and demonstrate continuous improvement. Know, understand and use software tools such as Lotus Notes, [Product name masked], SAP, Microsoft Office Programs, etc. Which enhance quality reporting. Ensure the suitability of laboratory equipment through proper operation, maintenance, calibration, verification and good quality control and assessment activities. Generate quality data and significant statistical data to support plant personnel in their efforts to enhance process control, meet customer requirements and continuously improve our product quality characteristics.
cond_0175.requirements:
The selected candidate must have the ability to work as part of a team, understand chemical and instrument measurement processes, be self-motivated, and willing to develop technical knowledge and understanding of the chemical and measurement processes involved in their respective units.
Experience working in a chemical manufacturing laboratory environment. Basic understanding of general chemistry. Basic understanding of theory, operation, calibration, maintenance and troubleshooting of laboratory instrumentation such as gas chromatographs, viscometers, spectrophotometers, pH meters, titrators, etc. Basic understanding of the techniques of quality assurance and quality control. Basic understanding of math and statistics. Basic understanding of ISO/RCMS quality system requirements. Basic computer skills using software packages such as Microsoft Office, Power BI, SAP, Lotus Notes, etc. Perform analysis of raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods, in a timely manner, to verify conformance to or prescribe appropriate adjustment to product so they meet specifications that have been agreed upon by [Company name masked] and their customers or suppliers. Associate must be willing to work in a team-oriented atmosphere. This includes learning all tasks and equipment associated with product testing, helping coordinate the flow of work within the team and with other departments, and helping team associates to meet changing work demands (i.e. Go where the work is).
Perform all tests on applicable products. Analyze and record the test results. Effectively communicate with operations. Interpret and follow documented procedures and STI's. Effectively communicate results to the appropriate personnel. Participate in safe work practices. Perform equipment control plan to verify conformance. Maintain a clean working environment. Perform effectively in a team-based environment. Perform all required health and safety inspections at prescribed frequencies. Computer literate; scientific minded and detail oriented.
Previous quality control experience including preferred 2 years chemistry related, environment preferred.
Physical Requirements:
Occasional lifting, bending and twisting of various range and motion requiring physical exertion when handling materials, drums or equipment. Occasional use of stairs required. Occasional use of respiratory protection.

Minimum Requirements
Experience working in a chemical manufacturing laboratory environment
Background in general chemistry
Familiarity with theory, operation, calibration, maintenance and troubleshooting of laboratory instrumentation such as gas chromatographs, viscometers, spectrophotometers, pH meters, titrators, etc.
Familiarity with quality assurance and quality control techniques
Working knowledge of math and statistics
Basic computer skills using software packages such as Microsoft Office, Power BI, SAP, Lotus Notes, etc.
Ability to perform analysis of raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods in a timely manner to verify conformance to or prescribe appropriate adjustment to product so they meet agreed specifications
Ability to work as part of a team, with openness to learning all tasks and equipment associated with product testing, helping coordinate workflow within the team and with other departments
Preferred Requirements
Around 2 years of chemistry-related quality control experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience
Exposure to ISO/RCMS quality system requirements
Willingness to develop technical knowledge and understanding of the chemical and measurement processes involved
Comfort interpreting and following documented procedures and STIs
Ability to communicate results effectively to operations and appropriate personnel

Occasional lifting, bending and twisting of various range and motion requiring physical exertion when handling materials, drums or equipment

cond_0425.responsibilities: Analyze raw materials, intermediate products, finished products and other chemical samples and evaluate suitability according to established specifications to ensure quality and availability of final product. Analyze samples, provide quality data and become an active member along with the Lab Supervisor and Production personnel to provide innovative ideas to improve lab and plant processes and demonstrate continuous improvement. Know, understand and use software tools such as Lotus Notes, [Product name masked], SAP, Microsoft Office Programs, etc. Which enhance quality reporting. Ensure the suitability of laboratory equipment through proper operation, maintenance, calibration, verification and good quality control and assessment activities. Generate quality data and significant statistical data to support plant personnel in their efforts to enhance process control, meet customer requirements and continuously improve our product quality characteristics.
cond_0425.requirements:
The selected candidate must have the ability to work as part of a team, demonstrate deep understanding of chemical and instrument measurement processes, show exceptional self-motivation, and possess substantial technical knowledge of the chemical and measurement processes involved in their respective units.
Demonstrated expertise working in a chemical manufacturing laboratory environment. Advanced knowledge of general chemistry. Strong command of theory, operation, calibration, maintenance and troubleshooting of laboratory instrumentation such as gas chromatographs, viscometers, spectrophotometers, pH meters, titrators, etc. Advanced knowledge of the techniques of quality assurance and quality control. Solid understanding of math and statistics. Advanced knowledge of ISO/RCMS quality system requirements. Strong command of software packages such as Microsoft Office, Power BI, SAP, Lotus Notes, etc. Proven track record performing analysis of raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods, in a timely manner, to verify conformance to or prescribe appropriate adjustment to product so they meet specifications that have been agreed upon by [Company name masked] and their customers or suppliers. Associate must be willing to work in a team-oriented atmosphere. This includes learning all tasks and equipment associated with product testing, helping coordinate the flow of work within the team and with other departments, and helping team associates to meet changing work demands (i.e. Go where the work is).
Perform all tests on applicable products. Analyze and record the test results. Effectively communicate with operations. Interpret and follow documented procedures and STI's. Effectively communicate results to the appropriate personnel. Participate in safe work practices. Perform equipment control plan to verify conformance. Maintain a clean working environment. Perform effectively in a team-based environment. Perform all required health and safety inspections at prescribed frequencies. Computer literate; scientific minded and detail oriented.
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in quality control, with a chemistry-related background strongly preferred.
Physical Requirements:
Occasional lifting, bending and twisting of various range and motion requiring physical exertion when handling materials, drums or equipment. Occasional use of stairs required. Occasional use of respiratory protection.
cond_0425.values: We value strong results, high standards, and the pursuit of excellent work. We believe organizations perform best when they are guided by ambition and quality.

People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the kind of chemical and measurement work involved.
cond_0445.responsibilities: Analyze raw materials, intermediate products, finished products and other chemical samples and evaluate suitability according to established specifications to ensure quality and availability of final product. Analyze samples, provide quality data and become an active member along with the Lab Supervisor and Production personnel to provide innovative ideas to improve lab and plant processes and demonstrate continuous improvement. Know, understand and use software tools such as Lotus Notes, [Product name masked], SAP, Microsoft Office Programs, etc. Which enhance quality reporting. Ensure the suitability of laboratory equipment through proper operation, maintenance, calibration, verification and good quality control and assessment activities. Generate quality data and significant statistical data to support plant personnel in their efforts to enhance process control, meet customer requirements and continuously improve our product quality characteristics.
cond_0445.requirements:
The selected candidate must have the ability to work as part of a team, understand chemical and instrument measurement processes, be self-motivated, and willing to develop technical knowledge and understanding of the chemical and measurement processes involved in their respective units.
Experience working in a chemical manufacturing laboratory environment. Basic understanding of general chemistry. Basic understanding of theory, operation, calibration, maintenance and troubleshooting of laboratory instrumentation such as gas chromatographs, viscometers, spectrophotometers, pH meters, titrators, etc. Basic understanding of the techniques of quality assurance and quality control. Basic understanding of math and statistics. Basic understanding of ISO/RCMS quality system requirements. Basic computer skills using software packages such as Microsoft Office, Power BI, SAP, Lotus Notes, etc. Perform analysis of raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods, in a timely manner, to verify conformance to or prescribe appropriate adjustment to product so they meet specifications that have been agreed upon by [Company name masked] and their customers or suppliers. Associate must be willing to work in a team-oriented atmosphere. This includes learning all tasks and equipment associated with product testing, helping coordinate the flow of work within the team and with other departments, and helping team associates to meet changing work demands (i.e. Go where the work is).
Perform all tests on applicable products. Analyze and record the test results. Effectively communicate with operations. Interpret and follow documented procedures and STI's. Effectively communicate results to the appropriate personnel. Participate in safe work practices. Perform equipment control plan to verify conformance. Maintain a clean working environment. Perform effectively in a team-based environment. Perform all required health and safety inspections at prescribed frequencies. Computer literate; scientific minded and detail oriented.
Previous quality control experience including preferred 2 years chemistry related, environment preferred.
Physical Requirements:
Occasional lifting, bending and twisting of various range and motion requiring physical exertion when handling materials, drums or equipment. Occasional use of stairs required. Occasional use of respiratory protection.

cond_0474.intro: This position is responsible for quality assurance testing of in-process samples, raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods within the scope of [Company name masked] Quality Policy. You will regularly use appropriate software to evaluate data against internal and external specifications, stay in close contact with lab and plant teams, and actively support continuous improvement of lab and plant processes through QA/QC activities to meet and exceed customer expectations.
cond_0474.responsibilities:
Analyze raw materials, intermediate products, finished products, and other chemical samples and evaluate suitability according to established specifications to ensure quality and availability of final product.
Analyze samples, provide quality data, and actively contribute as a member alongside the Lab Supervisor and Production personnel, sharing ideas to improve lab and plant processes and demonstrating continuous improvement.
Know, understand, and use software tools such as Lotus Notes, [Product name masked], SAP, Microsoft Office Programs, etc. To enhance quality reporting.
Ensure the suitability of laboratory equipment through proper operation, maintenance, calibration, verification, and good quality control and assessment activities.
Generate quality data and significant statistical data, and regularly communicate findings to plant personnel to support their efforts to enhance process control, meet customer requirements, and continuously improve product quality characteristics.
Perform analysis of raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods in a timely manner to verify conformance or prescribe appropriate adjustments so products meet agreed specifications.
Perform all tests on applicable products, analyze and record test results.
Clearly communicate results and findings to operations and other appropriate personnel on an ongoing basis.
Interpret and follow documented procedures and STIs.
Participate in safe work practices and perform all required health and safety inspections at prescribed frequencies.
Perform equipment control plan to verify conformance.
Maintain a clean working environment.
Work actively within a team-based environment, including learning all tasks and equipment associated with product testing, helping coordinate the flow of work within the team and with other departments, and helping team associates meet changing work demands.
cond_0474.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Experience working in a chemical manufacturing laboratory environment.
Basic understanding of general chemistry.
Basic understanding of the theory, operation, calibration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of laboratory instrumentation such as gas chromatographs, viscometers, spectrophotometers, pH meters, titrators, etc.
Basic understanding of quality assurance and quality control techniques.
Basic understanding of math and statistics.
Basic computer skills using software packages such as Microsoft Office, Power BI, SAP, Lotus Notes, etc.
Ability to work as part of a team and communicate regularly with operations and other departments.
Willingness to develop technical knowledge and understanding of the chemical and measurement processes involved.
Scientific minded and detail oriented.
Occasional lifting, bending, and twisting of various range and motion requiring physical exertion when handling materials, drums, or equipment. Occasional use of stairs. Occasional use of respiratory protection.
Preferred Requirements
Previous quality control experience, including 2 years of chemistry-related experience.
Basic understanding of ISO/RCMS quality system requirements.
Self-motivated and willing to take initiative in coordinating work flow and actively contributing ideas within the team.
